biography: Giuliano Raucci's passion for racing ignited amidst the vibrant chaos of São Paulo's karting scene. From a young age, he displayed a fearless determination, often pushing his modest kart beyond its limits, much to the chagrin of his father who funded his early career with his mechanic shop profits. One defining moment came at the age of 16, during the Brazilian National Karting Championship. Despite starting last after a mechanical failure in qualifying, Raucci relentlessly carved his way through the field, ultimately clinching victory on the final lap with a daring overtake that solidified his reputation as a rising star. Now, at 23, Raucci is in what many consider his peak, racing for Scorpion Racing with the support of A.Di Pietro Skin, aiming to prove himself on the international stage and secure a coveted spot in a top-tier racing series. His aggressive style, honed on the unforgiving karting tracks of Brazil, makes him a formidable opponent, though it can sometimes lead to costly mistakes. He is determined to refine his craft and become a champion.
drivingStyle: Raucci's driving style is characterized by an aggressive, late-braking approach. He thrives on pushing the car to its absolute limit, often flirting with the edge of grip. He is known for his daring overtakes and willingness to take risks, especially in the closing stages of a race. While his tire management can be inconsistent due to his aggressive corner entries, he possesses an uncanny ability to perform under pressure, often delivering his best laps when the stakes are highest. He favors a setup that prioritizes mechanical grip over aerodynamic efficiency, reflecting his preference for a car that feels alive and responsive beneath him.
rivalries: Marco Bellini: A bitter rivalry stemming from a controversial collision during a championship-deciding race, leaving Raucci with a DNF and a burning desire for revenge.

Isabelle Dubois: A clash of personalities and driving styles, with Dubois' calculated approach often contrasting with Raucci's raw aggression, leading to heated on-track battles and off-track tension.
Kenji Tanaka: A young Japanese driver who consistently matches Raucci's pace, their rivalry is rooted in mutual respect but fueled by the ambition to be recognized as the next big thing.
quirks: Always wears the same pair of worn-out racing gloves, believing they bring him luck.
Listens to a specific playlist of Brazilian samba music before every race to calm his nerves.
Has a habit of tracing the outline of the track on the steering wheel before the formation lap.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about pushing the limits until you find the edge, and then daring to go just a little bit further."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian National Karting Championship after starting last, showcasing his exceptional overtaking skills and unwavering determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Junior Series Championship, costing him the title and leaving him questioning his own judgment.
